finding: The Lifelines-ROAHD cohort study provides detailed data on reproductive health determinants and the impact of reproductive events on the health of mothers and their children, showing various findings related to menstrual cycles, infertility, pregnancy outcomes, and postpartum health.
mod_finding: Vaginal births accounted for 74.9% of deliveries, while instrumental vaginal births, elective caesarean sections, and emergency caesarean sections constituted 11.9%, 3.9%, and 9.3% respectively.
